text_block_list.text:
After showing off a run powerful enough to 
crack open a sea urchin, Gold Ship safely 
received the first keyword from Eishin 
Flash.

Afterward, Gold Ship ended up fighting 
over dessert with Tosen Jordan, who 
happened to be there.

Their feud runs so deep that they once 
argued over the thickness of yakitori 
sauce... (*Note: This is a completely 
fabricated memory made up by Gold Ship.)

The two Umamusume ended up clashing over 
what was practically an arbitrary 
grievance from Gold Ship. The final 
showdown would be settled on the track!
